title: eludite.debug.evaluate output
description: The value of an expression, or why it could not be evaluated.

state.description: `done`: evaluated (see `result`). `pending`: the adapter has not answered yet (only from the UI, which shows the answer when it arrives). `failed`: see `message`.

reference.description: Non-zero when the result has members.
Non-zero when the value has members; expand it by evaluating `evaluate_name` with `expand: true`.

evaluate_name.description: An expression that evaluates to this value.

message.description: Why it failed (for example the debugger's compile error).

stop.description: The stop the value was computed in.
